note: Pinned upstream sources for recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh. Every sha256 was observed on download and checked against the upstream statement in its `evidence` (OpenPGP signature, announcement checksum, or, where upstream publishes none, a file-by-file comparison with the upstream git tag). A null sha256 means not yet verified; the build refuses any source whose sha256 is null or mismatched.

freetype.licenseNote: FreeType is dual-licensed FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later; the FTL option is taken, so the GPL option is never relied on.

evidence.result: Announcement by Werner Lemberg (2024-08-12) lists this exact SHA-256 for freetype-2.13.3.tar.xz and names signing key ID BE6C3AAC63AD8E3F; the .sig is a GOOD signature made 2024-08-12T14:07:10Z by E30674707856409FF1948010BE6C3AAC63AD8E3F (uid Werner Lemberg <wl@gnu.org>; key fetched from keyserver.ubuntu.com, so the key binding rests on the announcement's key ID).

evidence.statement: FriBidi publishes no checksum or signature for the v1.0.16 release asset (GitHub release by dov, 2024-09-25; the asset has no GitHub digest).
evidence.result: All 122 tarball files that exist in the tag are byte-identical (git blob SHA-1) to the tag; the 65 tarball-only files are autotools output, man pages and pre-generated tables. The recipe deletes them and builds with meson from tag-identical files only.
evidence.sha256Basis: observed digest of the official release asset; not an upstream-published digest

evidence.result: The tarball and the tag contain the same 3568 files and every file is byte-identical (git blob SHA-1); there are no tarball-only files.
